transcript.text: Alright, let's get this coordination meeting started. We've got tomorrow's inbound delivery with one palletized lot of generator housings and one lot of communications cable reels, and I need to publish final lane assignments before the receiving crew leaves today. The draft plan currently treats all three staging lanes as interchangeable with no special receiving controls listed. Before I assign lanes, I need to hear from each of you -- warehouse ops NCO, movement control officer -- are there any changes or issues affecting tomorrow's receiving plan that I need to know about?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a special receiving control that's not on the draft plan. This morning I confirmed that only Lane 2 has a current floor-load certification for the 1,800-kilogram generator-housing pallet. The certification is filed in the warehouse binder, but it hasn't been added to the yard diagram yet. The generator housings need to go to Lane 2; the other lanes are not certified for that weight.
